performance.driver: Consolidated revenue increased $263.0 million or 17% for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, due to a $196.9 million or 13% increase from asset-based fees and a $66.1 million or 4% increase from performance-based fees, primarily in private markets strategies.

Revenue increased primarily due to a $24.2 million, or 10.3%, increase in revenue in our Health+ Segment, and an $8.9 million, or 3.6%, increase in revenue in our Military+ Segment, partially offset by an $8.0 million decrease in GSUSA revenue included in Corporate and Other for the period prior to the GSUSA Sale Date.

Operating income increased $1.1 million to $10.5 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 compared with operating income of $9.4 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025. The increase in operating income is primarily attributable to the increased volume described above partially offset by higher amortization expense and acquisition and integration expenses associated with Thermon.

Consolidated net sales were $129.6 million, an 11.8% decrease from the prior year quarter primarily due to lower available starting backlog, reduced traffic, fewer contract sales, lower delivered unit volume and a challenging environment for home furnishings partially offset by higher average ticket price and incremental designer floor sample sales.
Net sales increased 10.9% to $3,033 million for the third quarter of 2026, driven by volume / mix growth and higher net price realization.

The decrease was primarily driven by lower earned premiums.

performance.driver: Net sales in the Direct bedding channel decreased $36.8 million, or 11.0%, primarily driven by a decrease in sales from the divestiture of Sleep Outfitters. •Tempur Sealy International net sales increased $14.3 million, or 1.6%, primarily driven by strong performance in key markets.

Our revenues increased $122.0 million, or 7.8%, primarily due to an increase of $80.9 million in organic revenue growth primarily driven by strength in the SS&C GlobeOp fund administration and Global Investor and Distribution Solutions businesses.

Net sales increased $2,623 million, or 15.2%, in fiscal 2026 as compared to fiscal 2025. The increase in net sales resulted primarily from organic net sales growth of 11.9%, the positive impact of foreign currency translation of 2.2%, and the positive impact of 1.6% from acquisitions.

Operating income decreased by $12.7 million to $34.3 million in the third quarter of 2026 compared to $47.1 million in the third quarter of 2025, due primarily to an increase in amortization expenses as a result of the Keystone acquisition and decreased revenues as mentioned above.

Revenues increased by $10.8 million, or 4.0%, to $278.4 million during the six months ended September 30, 2026 from $267.6 million for the same period of the prior year. The increase was primarily due to a portfolio shift in mix to higher-yielding loans.

Total revenue increased by $228.9 million in the three months ended September 30, 2026 compared to the same period in 2025. The increase was driven primarily by the $250.0 million milestone from Jazz triggered by Ziihera's U.S. approval for GEA.
